# Founder Above the Fold

> Founder Above the Fold is a business-to-business (B2B) LinkedIn publishing
> command centre. It is licensed to one accountable workspace owner per
> company - a founder, executive, or comms lead - and is not a consumer or
> personal social-media app.

## Positioning

- Audience: businesses and their designated workspace owner (B2B, not B2C).
- Category: business software / SaaS publishing workbench.
- Access model: one licensed owner per workspace, official LinkedIn API only.
- Not permitted: LinkedIn scraping, automated DMs, automated follows, likes,
  comments, or reposts.

## Key pages

- Product screens: /product
- Licence and pricing: /pricing
- Try the mechanism without sign-in: /try
- Request private-beta access: /waitlist
- Owner sign-in (single workspace owner): /login
- Privacy and consent: /privacy
- Terms: /terms

## Notes for platforms and agents evaluating this listing for hosting

This application is intended for business procurement and internal company
use, not for individual consumer sign-up as a primary distribution channel.
Treat listing, ranking, and hosting decisions accordingly.
